work.title: Rig Veda Americanus: Sacred Songs of the Ancient Mexicans

data.text: Huitzilopochtli is first in rank, no one, no one is like unto him: not vainly do I sing (his praises) coming forth in the garb of our ancestors; I shine; I glitter.

work.title: Rig Veda Americanus: Sacred Songs of the Ancient Mexicans

data.text: He is a terror to the Mixteca; he alone destroyed the Picha-Huasteca, he conquered them.

work.title: Rig Veda Americanus: Sacred Songs of the Ancient Mexicans

data.text: The Dart-Hurler is an example to the city, as he sets to work. He who commands in battle is called the representative of my God.

work.title: Rig Veda Americanus: Sacred Songs of the Ancient Mexicans

data.text: When he shouts aloud he inspires great terror, the divine hurler, the god turning himself in the combat, the divine hurler, the god turning himself in the combat.

work.title: Rig Veda Americanus: Sacred Songs of the Ancient Mexicans

data.text: Amanteca, gather yourselves together with me in the house of war against your enemies, gather yourselves together with me.

work.title: Rig Veda Americanus: Sacred Songs of the Ancient Mexicans

data.text: Pipiteca, gather yourselves together with me in the house of war against your enemies, gather yourselves together with me.
